note: Cost figures are rendered to civilians as 'about $X'. No model ids in any user-facing field.

skills.when_pulled: Up front — asks the few work-changing questions before any drafting
Once interview signals are in — writes the first full draft
After a draft exists — strips jargon so a non-expert can act on it
When the job needs outside facts (rules, norms, requirements)
When the job involves money — checks what rates are typical
Verifies any factual claim in the draft against a real source
Checks the deal is balanced — flags one-sided terms
On approval — produces the clean, ready-to-send document

pull_rules.selection: two passes: interview signals, then the draft with a one-line reason per skill
pull_rules.model_policy: least expensive capable model; escalate once on verification fail or low confidence, then pause
